title: Tightness of the Tweakable XORP Security Bound
summary: No attack matching the tweakable XORP security bound is known; find such an attack or improve the bound.

formal_statement.body: Determine whether the security bound of the tweakable XORP construction is tight, or improve the bound.

scope.domain: Symmetric-key cryptanalysis of security bounds for the tweakable XORP construction.
parameters: n — parameter used to express the claimed security level of approximately two-thirds of n bits
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether an attack matching the security bound exists or the bound can instead be improved.

citations.label: Efficient Instances of Docked Double Decker With AES, and Application to Authenticated Encryption

progress.summary: The conclusion states that no attack matching the tweakable XORP bound is known and leaves finding one or improving the bound as future work.
citation_labels: Christoph Dobraunig et al., Efficient Instances of Docked Double Decker With AES, and Application to Authenticated Encryption
